描述
Unisex short-sleeve cotton T-shirt with a Y2K graphic print and round neckline. Pullover style for casual everyday wear.

FIT AND SIZE: This T-shirt has an oversized fit. Compare the garment measurements below with a T-shirt that fits you well. For the bust measurement, lay your T-shirt flat, measure from armpit to armpit, then double that width. Measurements are in cm; allow 2–3 cm variation due to manual measurement.
